mainEntity.name: What’s the realistic timeline for designing and building an ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text:
From first consultation to move-in, an ADU often takes 9–18 months, depending on design complexity, permitting, and construction capacity. The permitting and plan-check phase alone can take several months in many jurisdictions.

Construction itself is usually 4–8 months once plans are approved and the site is ready. Prefab or modular ADUs can be faster but still require foundation, utilities, and permits.

Key factors:
- Local planning and building department workloads
- Whether you choose standard plans or fully custom design
- Utility upgrades and site access conditions
- Contractor availability and material lead times

To keep things moving, decide early whether speed or customization is more important to you and choose a team experienced with ADUs in your area. Clarify who is responsible for plan submittals, revisions, and responding to city comments so your project doesn’t stall in paperwork.
